name: Wiesbaden
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 queue point in latitude/longitude order; not shifted to force a parcel hit.
registryBasis: The official Wiesbaden Geoportal identifies the municipal Tiefbau- und Vermessungsamt as its geoinformation custodian. Hessen's official ALKIS WFS, operated by the Hessian State Office for Land Management and Geoinformation, returned Wiesbaden parcel features.
blocker: A bounded WFS request verified safe parcel geometry and native IDs, but it did not establish citywide completeness or independently qualify a production adapter.

requests.assessment: Timed out after 20 seconds in the shell request; indexed official page identifies the viewer and visible layers. Timeout is not evidence of absence.
Returned WFS capabilities, service title, ALKIS scope, and feature type ave:Flurstueck.
Returned 3 parcel features with safe native oid identifiers and EPSG:25832 geometries. Response envelope/features were not treated as proof of citywide completeness.

remainingUncertainty: The Wiesbaden municipal viewer timed out from this shell path; the state WFS response was bounded and returned only three features, so citywide parcel coverage, update currency, exact point containment, and adapter suitability remain for serial review. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, or personal fields were retained.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently qualify the live WFS, coverage semantics, coordinate handling, and native identity before any runtime admission; keep held meanwhile.
